name: svg_maker
description: THE ONLY WAY to create SVG icons or vector logos. Call this tool DIRECTLY (via tool_search) the moment the user asks for an svg, icon, or vector logo — never hand-write SVG manually with other tools. Takes a plain description of the wanted image (what it shows, style, colors) and returns RAW SVG CODE ONLY plus the saved .svg file in the working folder. The tool owns an internal single-shot session with its own icon system prompt (simple 24x24 icon basics); the same text model draws the icon and the tool validates it. Output is the svg code as-is.

description.description: What the icon shows (subject, style, colors). 1..2000 chars, e.g. 'blue outline shopping cart icon'.

icon_name.description: File base name for the saved .svg in the working folder (letters, numbers, _ -; default derived from description).

size.description: Width/height in px, 16..512 (default 48). Sets width/height on the svg root.
